description: This file defines a configuration class for Google Image Generation API integration within an image transformation module. It includes methods for parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response handling specific to Google Gemini API models.

classes.name: GoogleImageGenConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for interacting with Google Gemini image generation API, providing methods for URL formation, parameter mapping, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns the list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for Google API.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Google Gemini API parameters based on supported parameters.

methods.name: str _map_size_to_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
methods.description: Maps image size string to an aspect ratio string.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API request URL based on model, base URL, and other parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets required headers, primarily ensuring the Gemini API key is available.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a prompt and parameters into the request body formatted for the Gemini API.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_generation_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ImageResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Parses the raw response from the API into the internal ImageResponse format.
